collections.title: Aerial Imaging
collections.mainContent:
See the big picture with aerial photography

Drone technology has come along way in recent years and it is now at a point where you can achieve remarkable results without too much fuss. Whether it be still or moving footage, aerial photography/videography provides a unique perspective. PropertyMedia currently operates under the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau (JCAB) rules. There are a number of safety considerations and laws that need to be followed when operating a drone. PropertyMedia is aware of these requirements and will only undertake work that is safe and within the JCAB Drone Rules.

Section size

Our technology is not restricted to where someone can walk eg.  Taking a photo looking back at a property on a hill top, or above water.

Context

Aerial photography makes it possible to show the property's proximity to local amenities eg. Supermarkets, Schools and Medical Centers.

Subdivisions

Encompassing high aerial shots with map style views showcase the entire land and subdivisions.
